title: Majority Element
description: Find the element that appears more than half the time using Boyer-Moore voting.

data.text: Given an array `nums` of size `n`, return the majority element — the element that appears more than `⌊n / 2⌋` times. You may assume the majority element always exists.
Count each value in a dictionary and return the one with the highest count. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: HashMap O(n)

data.text: Pair off different elements. The majority element cannot be fully cancelled out. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Boyer-Moore O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) both ways. **Space:** O(n) → O(1). The voting algorithm works because the majority appears more than half the time — it always survives the cancelling process.
